cancellation_summary: You may cancel up to 7 days in advance for a full refund.
description: The Honu Lele is a 33ft World Cat fast 6-passenger vessel. She has plenty of shade, fresh water shower, and the ability to get you places quickly. Since you have chartered the boat you have a wide variety of options to choose from
what_is_included:
- Snorkel or scuba gear
- Boxed lunch
- Drinks
itinerary: - Customized itinerary based on guest preferences for snorkel or scuba activities
highlights:
- Private charter on a 33ft fast vessel
- Fully customizable experience with snorkel or scuba options
- Includes lunch and drinks
check_in_details: Arrive 15 minutes before departure; waivers must be signed by 5 PM the evening before.
what_to_bring:
- Reusable water bottle
- Sun-protective clothing (reef-safe sunscreen only)
special_requirements:
- Must be in good health with no heart conditions
- Contact us for any special needs prior to the charter
restrictions: - Reef-safe sunscreen is required; toxic sunscreens are prohibited
faqs:
- **What happens if I don’t have my certification card?** We will not take you diving without proof of certification.
- **Is gratuity included?** No, gratuity is not included but is highly appreciated.
